race.comment: IMMORTAL BLISS (5) continues to show plenty of class, winning impressively on a Heavy deck at Belmont before a short break. Only 56 days between runs and his recent trial was superb. Things look to work out nicely for him here and if he can run up to his latest effort, he bring up back-to-back wins. RISSOLES (10) is third-up today and looks primed for a bold showing with some strong foundations being laid to begin her campaign. CJP rides now from a favourable alley and she can't be discounted. CESSATION (9) is a speedy customer who will give a bold sight on resumption. WEST STAR (4) is right in this on his best form.
